coder_notes: All three drugs are investigational together in the single arm with Sonocloud-9 ultrasound BBB opening, so experimental_combination and device_dependent. Microbubbles are not a registered drug intervention but every patient receives them for BBB opening (listed as delivery_enabling; agent unnamed). Liposomal doxorubicin flagged new_formulation (liposomal form of doxorubicin). p-ERK is a baseline predictive marker (not PD); immune profile and ctDNA pre/post sonication are biomarker endpoints not explicitly linked to a candidate's target, hence target_engagement unclear. MGMT unmethylated is an entry requirement but not candidate-matched.
